title: Grateful Dead Live at Onongada County War Memorial on 1982-04-08
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi CR-7A) -> Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.8 MHz) ->Samplitude Professional v11.2.1 -> FLAC
source: (2) Beyer M160's + (1) Sennheiser 421 -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M)

ai_review.summary: High‑resolution, sweet‑sounding recording with energetic but uneven performance
ai_review.review: The 24‑bit FLAC capture is praised for its crystal‑clear, sweet tonal quality, making the soundboard‑like audio a highlight. The show itself was lively yet a bit sloppy, with Garcia’s playing described as “all over the place,” leading to mixed feelings about the musical execution.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong positive comments on recording quality (4‑5 stars) offset by a lukewarm 3‑star review that criticizes the performance; combined weighted average yields ~3.5.

recording_quality.technical_notes: 24‑bit FLAC praised as crisp and sweet‑sounding; some reviewers note a vocal‑heavy mix typical of audience recordings.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Described as sloppy and “all over the place” by one reviewer.
